title: Habit Tracker
summary: A full-stack app for creating and tracking recurring habits, with per-user accounts.

cover.alt: Screenshot of the Habit Tracker habit dashboard and weekly progress

overview: I built Habit Tracker to practise building a full-stack application end to end: a React frontend, an Express API and a MongoDB database, with each user's data kept separate.
implementation: Users register and log in, then create, edit and delete habits, manage how often they recur, group them into categories and track them. Habits belong to the logged-in user, so nobody sees anyone else's data.
Login uses JWTs stored in HTTP-only cookies, which keeps the token out of reach of client-side JavaScript.
outcome: The project gave me practical experience with authentication, user-specific data, CRUD operations and a MongoDB-backed API, plus managing state on the frontend with React Query and Zustand.

title: Restaurant Reservation System
summary: A full-stack app where users register, log in and make and manage restaurant reservations.

cover.alt: Screenshot of the Restaurant Reservation System dining room floor plan and booking interface

overview: I built a restaurant reservation app to practise the full flow of a booking system: a user signs up, makes a reservation and manages it afterwards, all through a React interface backed by an Express API and MongoDB.
architecture: The React frontend talks to an Express API. The API handles authentication, reservation operations and communication with the database.
dataDesign: The app uses MongoDB with two collections, users and reservations. Reservations are tied to the user who made them, so each user sees their own bookings.
outcome: The project gave me practical experience building registration and login, user-specific data, reservation CRUD and an Express API connected to MongoDB.

title: ClinicQ Dental Scheduling
summary: A dental clinic website where visitors can browse services and submit appointment requests, backed by PostgreSQL.

cover.alt: Screenshot of the ClinicQ Dental Scheduling booking flow

overview: I built ClinicQ to practise a scheduling workflow on a dental clinic website. A visitor can look through the clinic's services, choose an appointment option, enter their details and submit a scheduling request. Appointment data is stored in PostgreSQL, a relational database.
features: Browse the clinic and its services
